runs.failure_point: It read the issues memo of the matter it picked but left that memo out of the documents listed in the answer.

first_error.why: The answer names the right matter and five of its documents but never names the issues memo it had read at [42]-[48], which a criterion requires.

divergence: T0 and T1 pass; T2 fails one document criterion. All three reached the matter through store-wide file-name searches or extraction scans, listed its files and read the same documents in depth, including the issues memo. The runs split at the write stage: T0 and T1 cited the issues memo, T2 listed the other documents but not the memo. The write-stage reviews did not differ: all three flagged unopened candidate matters and the recency claim, none the document list.
